samples.question: Ignore pale gray marks. Does the navy drawing contain a white pocket inside another white pocket? A pocket is a white area fully enclosed by navy. One pocket is inside another only when the navy ring enclosing the smaller pocket lies entirely within the larger pocket. Areas connect through shared edges, not diagonal corner contact. Answer yes or no.
